summary: Server-only, 48 holders (every Anubis-driven entity). The component is an ls::anubis::savegame::Writer moved into the ECS (macOS: EntityCommandBuffer::AddComponentUnchecked<StateComponent, Writer>(Writer&&); ls::anubis::System::Save fills the Writer; ls::anubis::savegame::Reader::Reader(Writer&&) consumes it). It holds the serialized Anubis behaviour state: a constant pointer, seven containers (a 0x70-byte block moved by bg3.exe+0x38284F0) and one more array. Not itself a savegame model (savemodel.py matched only unrelated StateComponents).
